home.seoDescription: Studafy brings academics, attendance, grades, discipline, finance, and family communication into one school management platform.
home.heroTitle: Studafy: school operations, in one system
home.heroSubtitle: Academics, attendance, grades, discipline, finance, and family communication — one platform your staff and families both actually use.
home.includedLede: Not a bolt-on gradebook or a standalone fee tracker — the modules below share the same student, class, and school records.

academics.title: Academics & attendance
academics.body: Terms, subjects, classes, timetables, enrollment, and daily attendance — with corrections that keep an audit trail instead of silently overwriting a record.

grades.title: Grades & discipline
grades.body: Gradebooks, assignments, submissions, and exam results staff can enter and publish, plus discipline records and evaluations in the same system.

finance.title: Finance & billing
finance.body: Fee structures, installments, scholarships and discounts, payments, refunds, and reconciliation — with reporting that adds up for finance staff, not just for parents.

family.title: Family portal & notifications
family.body: Guardians see attendance, grades, and balances for each child, and get notified through the channels your school already uses.

home.howTitle: Set up once, run every term

onboard.title: Your school onboards
onboard.body: We set up your school as its own tenant with its own data, roles, and permissions.

staff.title: Staff run the school day-to-day
staff.body: Teachers, admins, and finance staff work in one system instead of switching between spreadsheets and separate tools.

families.title: Families stay in the loop
families.body: Guardians get a live portal and notifications — no more chasing down a printed report card.

home.ctaTitle: See it against your own school’s numbers
home.ctaBody: Tell us about your school and we’ll walk you through Studafy — including where it won’t be a fit, if that’s the case.

features.seoDescription: Academics, attendance, grades, discipline, finance, family portal, and an optional AI add-on — see what's included in Studafy.
features.heroTitle: One system for the whole school day
features.heroSubtitle: Every group below shares the same student, class, and school records — nothing here is a separate tool bolted on afterward.

academics.title: Academics
academics.body: The structure everything else hangs off of.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: Daily records with a real audit trail.

items.entry: Grade entry with a publish step

discipline.title: Discipline
discipline.body: Incidents and evaluations on the student record.

family.title: Family portal & notifications
family.body: What guardians see, and how they hear about it.

items.siblings: Multi-child comparison for guardians with siblings enrolled

approvals.title: Approvals & audit
approvals.body: A record of who changed what, and who signed off.

items.queue: A shared approval queue for review-gated actions

features.aiBody: A grounded question-and-answer assistant that cites the school records it draws from, plus a study-material summarizer. It’s opt-in on top of a school subscription, purchased per student, and metered against a monthly usage budget rather than sold as unlimited — see <0>pricing</0> for how it’s billed.

pricing.heroSubtitle: One subscription per school. Every plan includes the same modules — the difference is scale, described on each plan below.

pricing.addOnNote: Ask us for current add-on pricing when you talk to us about a school plan.

about.seoDescription: What Studafy is, and how to get in touch about bringing it to your school.
about.heroSubtitle: A school operations platform, built as one system rather than a bundle of separate tools.
about.body1: Studafy runs the day-to-day of a school in a single system: academics and timetabling, attendance, grades and assessments, discipline, finance and billing, and a family portal with notifications — all sharing the same student, class, and school records instead of syncing between separate tools.
about.body2: Actions that need a second set of eyes — grade publishing, discipline decisions, and other review-gated changes — go through a shared approval queue with an audit trail, so there’s a record of who signed off and when.
about.body3: Each school is provisioned as its own tenant, with its own data, roles, and permissions. An optional AI add-on (grounded question-answering and study-material summaries) is available on top of a school subscription.
about.contactLede: Tell us about your school and we’ll walk you through Studafy.
